name: MonarchCheckboxToggleStyle
title: Checkbox
summary: A checkbox look for the standard Toggle, because iOS has no checkbox control. Supports the mixed state.
whenToUse: For selecting one or more items, or for agreeing to terms.
whenNotToUse: For a setting that takes effect immediately, use a plain Toggle (a switch).

states.name: unchecked
states.description: Empty box with the input border.

states.name: mixed
states.description: Filled box with a dash, from Toggle(sources:isOn:).

states.name: disabled
states.description: Muted box and the disabled text colour.

appearance: The checked box is filled with the strong accent in every theme; the unchecked box is a surface with the input border.
platformNotes: Android uses the Material 3 Checkbox and the web its own Checkbox. iOS has no checkbox, so this is a ToggleStyle and the control stays a Toggle.
accessibility: VoiceOver is given a standard Toggle with the same label and binding, so role, value and activation are the system's.
The whole row, label included, is the touch target and is at least 44 points high.
The box and the label scale with Dynamic Type.
The checked state is shown with a glyph, not colour alone.
edgeCases: A long label wraps beside the box.
The mixed state toggles every source on, as Toggle(sources:) defines.

examples.title: Inline label and indeterminate
